COST: 448

Notes on the plan:
- Only kispang-shelter and benighat-hospital are used as evacuation points. Dhunche temple is not designated, so nobody is dropped there.
- The Kakani temple to Dhunche temple road is avoided because of fast floodwater. The Trishuli care home to Syaphru care home road is closed, and the Galchhi temple to Trishuli care home bridge is gone.
- Driving costs total 308 minutes (car1 10, car2 298). Deferral penalties total 140: 2 adults at Tarkeshwar farm (40) and 2 elderly at Shivapuri care home (100).
- Shivapuri care home is only reachable through the long Kakani temple to Galchhi temple road (about 55 minutes each way). Round-trip driving there costs more than the penalty for deferring those two, so they are deferred.
- Some alternative splits of the Syaphru and Tarkeshwar groups cost the same, so this is one of several equally cheap plans.
